stemMd: What fraction equals the repeating decimal 0.272727...?
explanationMd: Let x=0.272727... Then 100x−x=27, so 99x=27 and x=27/99=3/11. The two-digit repeating block determines the factor 99.

distractorRationale.d: This simplifies to 0.3, not the specified repeating decimal.
distractorRationale.c: This has a different repeating expansion.
